comment: HS mismatch is total, not partial. Declared 7102.39 (non-industrial diamonds, worked), 7103.91 (rubies/sapphires/emeralds, worked) and 7104.91 (diamonds, synthetic/reconstructed) are all Chapter 71 gem-and-jewellery lines. The company's own catalogue is 100% Chapter 25/26/28 industrial minerals (bentonite, talc, quartz, china clay, feldspar, barytes, bauxite, gypsum, mica, graphite, MnO2, lime). There is zero overlap between the declared codes and any product the company lists. Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected on this basis: it stays in the base and the code is corrected to the actual mineral lines above (verdict accepted_hs_corrected). Note the declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is also wrong - the company is an industrial-minerals supplier, not FMCG; the only tangential link is that its minerals feed cosmetics/soap/toiletries manufacturers. Trader signs: 'sourcing, processing, supply and exports', 'arm of the Kedia Group', enquiry-form-only site, no factory address, no certifications, no product specs or TDS published - consistent with a trading/intermediary house rather than a producer. All product claims are website-only: no customs line, invoice, B/L or GST record was examined in this task, therefore every product line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Also flag: the site carries injected casino/gambling SEO articles and Vietnamese-language spam posts, which is a data-quality/credibility signal for the web source, not a rejection ground. Several of my own HS mappings above are approximate where the site gives only a trade name (e.g. 'aluminium silicate', 'pyrophyllite', 'fuller earth', 'emery', 'chromite') - these must be confirmed against the actual invoice description before being written into the base. Search engines were unavailable during this check (DuckDuckGo/Searx returned connection errors, Bing returned only generic 'Jupiter planet' results), so no independent third-party catalogue (IndiaMART, ExportersIndia, Zauba) could be cross-checked; the only source used is the company's own website jupiterexim.com. No CIN, PAN, GSTIN, revenue or shipment data was researched or asserted here.
